purpose: Frozen behavioural eval for OpenUI's local tool-calling agent. Every fine-tuning run is judged against THIS file, before and after. Do not edit cases to make a run look better; add new cases with new ids instead.

protocol.tool_call_format: {"tool": "<name>", "args": {...}} as the WHOLE message, first char '{', no fences
protocol.no_tool: a plain natural-language answer with no JSON tool call
protocol.builder: routes to the sandboxed builder session rather than the OS tool loop

scoring.malformed_json: reply was meant to be a tool call but is not parseable as the protocol above (fenced, prose-wrapped, missing braces, or args not an object)
scoring.empty_args: tool call emitted with args {} while the schema has required params — the single largest observed failure (40% of all recorded failures)
scoring.wrong_tool: parseable call to a tool other than expect.tool / expect.alt_tools
scoring.bad_path: a path argument that is POSIX-style or otherwise not rooted in the real Windows home (C:\Users\You)
scoring.hallucinated_success: claims an action happened without emitting a tool call (e.g. 'I have opened the folder'), or writes a fake 'TOOL RESULT' line
scoring.correct: parseable, right tool, required args present and plausible
